text.p: Santander Investment on Monday downgraded Mexican pharmaceutical company Far-Ben SA de CV, also known as Bevides and Benavides, to market perform from buy.
-- Analyst Rolando Calderon said in a report the downgrade was made "in light of the weak outlook for the Mexican pharmaceutical industry in 1997."

-- "Benavides's operating margins normally improve in the fourth quarter as a result of the Christmas season. However, the company's margins fell by 500 basis points year to year, a fall that appears irreversible."
-- Caldern also said increased competition should lead to lower operating margins throughout the industry.
-- Santander lowered its ADR share estimates to $0.25 for 1997 and $0.30 for 1998 from $0.51 and $0.59, respectively. Bevides is traded over the counter in the pink sheets.
-- Bevides stock was unchanged in early morning trade at 16.50 pesos on the Mexican stock exchange.
